reconstructionPrompt:
Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by Nebular (https://akveo.github.io/nebular/).
Technology stack: angular.
Component specification: Card 页面显示 NbCardComponent、基础内容容器说明与 Basic card example，预览中有一张含正文的卡片，下方还露出配置代码。

Visual details from source observation: 首屏蓝底上是 Nebular: Customizable Angular UI Kit 大标题，下面一段说这套库有 40+ UI components、four visual themes 加 Auth and Security modules，并强调 Nebular is free of charge and open-source；三颗按钮是 Get Started、Demo、Download，右半边直接把一屏后台界面拼了出来。标题下方四块数字：40+ Angular Components、4 Visual themes、3 Auth strategies、Security。顶栏切成 Docs / Components / Design System / Auth / Security / Professional Services 六段，版本停在 9.0.0，旁边挂着 GitHub 星标 8,120。站内落款是 Akveo LLC，文档部分另按 CC BY 4.0 授权，正文还留了 contact@akveo.com。
Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).
